newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian drinks bottler SFBT 96 div flat.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian drinks bottler SFBT 96 div flat.

text.p: Tunisian beverage firm Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis said it will start on Tuesday distributing a 2.5 dinar dividend per share on its 1996 results, unchanged from its level in 1995.
The company's profits for 1996 amounted to 4.109 million dinars, up from 3.231 million dinars in 1995.
SFBT, which is the country's bottler for beer and Coca-Cola, has a capital of 9.5 million dinars, 20 percent of which was sold to the public on the Tunis Stock Exchange in 1995. ($= 1.1060 dinar)
